content.value_statement: Sender Profile onboarding requires coordinated choices across identity, billing, channels, campaigns, callbacks, and access. This skill turns those choices into a guarded provisioning sequence.
actual_capabilities: Plans profile creation with explicit inheritance, sharing, billing, and sandbox settings.
Explains the three supported WhatsApp attachment paths and their credential requirements.
Guides completion callbacks, status reconciliation, idempotency, and polling recovery.
Builds profile-scoped 10DLC campaign registration plans with documented validation constraints.
Plans user invitations, role changes, removals, and API key rotation with operator confirmation.
limitations: Requires valid Sent API credentials and appropriate organization permissions.
Does not start WhatsApp Embedded Signup because that flow is available only in the Sent Dashboard.
Does not create, list, revoke, or rotate API keys through an API.
Cannot replace legal, compliance, billing, or campaign approval decisions.

use_cases.title: Onboard a new tenant
use_cases.description: Create an isolated Sender Profile, attach channels, register campaigns, and complete provisioning.

use_cases.title: Recover stalled provisioning
use_cases.description: Interpret callback and profile statuses, then design safe polling and reconciliation.

use_cases.title: Administer profile access
use_cases.description: Review users, choose least-privilege roles, and prepare confirmed access changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic profile plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a sandbox-first Sender Profile for [tenant name] with isolated contacts and templates.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a clear creation sequence.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a WhatsApp path
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the supported WhatsApp attachment paths for [tenant context] and list required prerequisites.
prompt_templates.scenario: A team must select inheritance or dedicated credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Recover a missed callback
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reconciliation for profile [profile ID] after its completion callback was missed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Operations need a reliable polling recovery process.

prompt_templates.title: Design multi-tenant provisioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan profile creation, campaign registration, callback correlation, user roles, and offboarding for [platform architecture].
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced platform needs end-to-end tenant lifecycle controls.

output_examples.input: Plan an isolated profile for Northwind with organization billing.
output_examples.output: A staged checklist covering credentials, isolation flags, sandbox validation, live creation, campaign setup, completion, callback recovery, and access review.

output_examples.input: Why is profile completion still pending?
output_examples.output: A status assessment that separates callback delivery from final state and defines polling, timeout, correlation, and escalation steps.

output_examples.input: Invite a developer without risking administrator access.
output_examples.output: A least-privilege change plan that reads current users, confirms the target, invites the developer, and verifies active status.

best_practices: Validate uncertain payloads in sandbox with a separate idempotency key before live provisioning.
Set inheritance and sharing flags explicitly to preserve tenant isolation.
Require operator confirmation immediately before user role changes or removals.
anti_patterns: Do not log, echo, persist, or commit payment card fields or access tokens.
Do not treat a successful completion request as final profile approval.
Do not infer tenant ownership from shared account identifiers in webhook events.

faq.question: Can this skill create a Sender Profile?
faq.answer: It can plan and execute the documented REST workflow when valid credentials and operator approval are available.

faq.question: Does it support sandbox validation?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends sandbox validation and a different idempotency key for the live request.

faq.question: Can it start WhatsApp Embedded Signup?
faq.answer: No. Organization Embedded Signup must be completed in the Sent Dashboard.

faq.question: How does it handle missed completion callbacks?
faq.answer: It uses profile polling as the recovery authority and preserves unknown status values for review.

faq.question: Can it manage users and roles?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers invitations, role changes, removals, least privilege, and confirmation before mutations.

faq.question: Can it rotate API keys automatically?
faq.answer: No. Key creation and revocation are dashboard operations, but the skill documents a controlled rotation sequence.
